name: MusicBrainz Picard
description: Tag and rename your music from the MusicBrainz database.
notes: It runs as a desktop in the browser, with no password of its own: keep it to your LAN and tailnet. Your music is in /storage, written as the apps' user (set APPS_MEDIA_UID and APPS_MEDIA_GID to your media's owner). Turn off its update check under Options → Advanced → Network → Check for updates: CirrusStore updates it. The image is for x86-64 (amd64) only.
